title: Indifferentiability Under Non-Independent S-Boxes
summary: Existing indifferentiability guarantees assume independent random S-boxes; it remains unresolved whether comparable guarantees extend to dependent S-boxes.

formal_statement.body: Determine whether the indifferentiability guarantees for confusion-diffusion networks established under independent random S-boxes can be extended to models in which the S-boxes are non-independent within a round, within a zone, or throughout the network, and derive corresponding or comparable indifferentiability bounds for each dependence scope. [S1]

scope.domain: This concerns symmetric-cryptographic indifferentiability analysis of confusion-diffusion networks.
assumptions: Independent random S-boxes underpin the established indifferentiability guarantees.
parameters: S-box dependence scope: within a round, within a zone, or throughout the network
scope.unresolved_remainder: Determine whether the indifferentiability guarantees extend to non-independent S-boxes at each stated scope, together with corresponding or comparable bounds for each scope.

progress.summary: The source presents extending Theorem 1 or Theorem 2 to non-independent S-boxes as a potential research direction. It identifies dependence within a round, within a zone, or throughout the network as progressively broader scopes.
citation_labels: Yevgeniy Dodis et al., Indifferentiability of Confusion-Diffusion Networks
